text:
Rae (Docs): Hey team — assembling a super-compact migration card for the v1 -> v2 sunset email. target: one paragraph of "what changed", two tiny copy-paste snippets (JS + Py), one safe fallback pattern, and a 3-bullet gotchas list. want to keep it very short for the email CTA.
Owen (SDK): +1. please include exact call mapping and the small param rename table we keep seeing. recommend we call out: `models.invoke` -> `responses.create`, streaming moves to `responses.stream`, and `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens`. also mention older SDKs require `Authorization` header.
Rae (Docs): plan for snippets — JS: show old vs new; Py: same. will keep them runnable. JS draft:
```js
// v1
const resp = await client.models.invoke({ model: 'rwd-core', input: prompt })
// v2
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-core-v2', input: prompt })
```
Rae (Docs): Python draft:
```py
# v1
resp = client.models.invoke(model='rwd-core', input=prompt)
# v2
resp = client.responses.create(model='rwd-core-v2', input=prompt)
```
Sofia (Product): product asks for a minimal runtime fallback snippet customers can paste into their services prior to cutoff. non-opinionated, just show alias lookup + one retry.
Rae (Docs): adding tiny fallback example (pseudo):
```js
// fallback: try preferred alias, then compatible fallback
const alias = { primary: 'rwd-core-v2', fallback: 'rwd-core-compat' }
try { out = await client.responses.create({ model: alias.primary, input }) }
catch (e) { out = await client.responses.create({ model: alias.fallback, input }) }
```
Owen (SDK): please also add a single-line about streaming: "If you used streaming with v1, switch to responses.stream and parse framed JSON chunks (for await ...)." and link to the streaming migration doc.
Rae (Docs): got it. gotchas bullets I'll include in the card: 1) param renames (max_tokens -> max_output_tokens), 2) streaming framing change, 3) quota/error-code mapping (429 -> QUOTA_EXCEEDED in some cases).
Owen (SDK): can you add a tiny smoke-test that imports the snippets? we should catch copy-paste issues before the email goes out — I'll add a CI job that runs docs/snippets/migration/migrate_v1_v2.test.js.
preview-bot: Preview will be created once the PR is pushed and CI passes. :robot_face:
Sofia (Product): timeline: we want this linked from the deprecation email next Thursday. Rae, can you open a draft PR by Wed EOD?
Rae (Docs): yes — I'll open a draft PR and tag @Owen and @Sofia for review. PR will include runnable snippet files and a one-line changelog entry. posting link when ready.
Owen (SDK): will review snippets and add smoke-test. +1 for short wording.
Sofia (Product): +1
Rae (Docs): thanks — aiming to merge by Thu AM so the email links are stable.
